answer: An agent economy can weight governance votes by tokens locked for 90 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents still buys only 100 tokens of voting power. A plume of new accounts cannot turn into a tide of extra votes: the accounting makes that crystal clear. To gain control, an attacker must acquire a majority of the locked stake and bear its purchase cost and 90 days of lost liquidity.
